scientific_boundaries: The source freezes the Eq.11.44 smoothing formula but the current photographed evidence does not provide a numerical epsilon value.
No default epsilon is introduced. Every split/flux call requires epsilon_m_per_s explicitly.
epsilon=0 is accepted only as the exact Eq.11.43 raw-split limit and as a regression case; it is not promoted as the teacher production epsilon.
The literal Eq.11.42 formula exactly matches the existing Steger-Warming implementation in the calorically-perfect constant-property limit.

With the project's source-backed variable cp and absolute species energy, literal Eq.11.42 recombines mass and momentum flux but does not exactly reconstruct the physical Euler energy flux. The first CI run exposed a representative energy mismatch of about 20.9 percent.
This is treated as a scientific compatibility blocker rather than relaxed with a numerical tolerance or hidden correction. No unsourced energy correction is introduced.
The literal variable-composition FVS is therefore an isolated source-transcription/audit path only and must not replace the accepted Rusanov integrated solver.
The per-area implementation divides the textbook area-weighted Eq.11.42 by A because the repository residual multiplies numerical face fluxes by area already.
next_step: Do not integrate literal Eq.11.42 into the variable-thermochemistry solver yet. Re-audit the teacher/Cao references for how temperature-dependent cp and absolute mixture enthalpy were reconciled with Steger-Warming. If no source-backed reconciliation exists, retain the boundary-complete Rusanov path as the defensible integrated teacher compatibility solver and record Steger-Warming as an unresolved numerical-model compatibility item.
